title: Wojtek the Soldier Bear

slides.title: THE WAR ENDED. WOJTEK'S STORY DIDN'T.

slides.text: Private Wojtek served with the Polish army through the Middle East and Italy, and became the company's badge.
1946. The company was sent to a camp in Scotland, and Wojtek came too. Local people came to see the famous soldier bear.
When the unit was disbanded in 1947, Wojtek went to live at Edinburgh Zoo.
His old comrades came to visit. Some said he still perked up whenever he heard someone speaking Polish.
Wojtek died in 1963, at about 21 years old.
Today there are statues of him in Edinburgh, Krakow and other towns. A bear who crossed three continents with an army.
